### Hope for the Weary - Today's Insight - March 8, 2021
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-march-8-2021.html
Passage: Isaiah 50:4
Points:
- Weariness can arise from everyday responsibilities, prolonged waiting, spiritual conflict, or criticism.
- Left unaddressed, deep exhaustion threatens to extinguish personal hope, motivation, and optimism.
- God wakens His servants morning by morning to understand His will and bring comfort to the exhausted.
- The Lord does not merely provide a quick remedy; He offers His own tireless presence to sustain us.

### Fire Up or Torch? - Encouragement Café - November 20
Author: Luann Prater
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/fire-up-or-torch-encouragement-cafe-january-13.html
Passage: Isaiah 50:4
Points:
- Like a concentrated welding flame, the human tongue possesses the capacity either to tear apart or to mend.
- Careless remarks can burn and wound, whereas well-chosen words bring life and rekindle a fainting spirit.
- Believers must look to God each morning to receive an instructed ear and a gentle tongue.
- Followers of Christ should pray for guided speech that faithfully repairs and encourages weary hearts.
